title: Pull it down
brief:
Fetching refreshed your cache, but your branch is still behind. `git status` says so in plain words.

Fetching shows you the work; pulling brings it into your branch. `git pull` is `git fetch` plus `git merge origin/main`. When you have no commits of your own, that merge is a fast-forward: the main pointer simply slides forward.

goals.label: main has caught up to origin/main

hints: git status tells you how far behind origin/main you are.
git pull fetches, then fast-forwards your main onto origin/main.
